Netherlands
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Den Haag, Netherland
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of the Kingdom of the Netherlands are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovinaup up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
